guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile is encountering an error during the step where the 'conda create' command is run to create the 'testbed' Python environment. The error is due to the Terms of Service for the specified Conda channels not being accepted. To fix this, the Dockerfile should include the necessary commands to accept the Terms of Service before running the 'conda create' command. Update the Dockerfile as follows: 

Step to include: 
RUN conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main && conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r 

Place this command right before the 'conda create' step (Step 15 in the Dockerfile). This ensures that the Terms of Service are accepted and the error is avoided.
